mechanism_narrative: A higher federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses equity valuations by increasing the discount rate for future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the cost of capital rises.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of observations when FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.2 percentage points over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings pressure.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.2pp in 3 months, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: The joint occurrence of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and restrictive policy rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals persistent inflationary pressures forcing prolonged monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: high inflation and high rates regime
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 3.5 and FEDFUNDS > 4.0, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals weakening residential demand, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced economic momentum and corporate revenue concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances during late-cycle expansion when HOUST declines, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strengthening manufacturing activity and economic output, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days by boosting corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of observations when INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly growth rate in retail sales (RSAFS) below 0.5% signals weak consumer spending, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations and economic slowdown concerns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS growth rate < 0.5% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A strong quarterly GDP growth rate (GDPC1) as of the previous quarter signals robust economic expansion, which typically supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days by reinforcing corporate earnings momentum and investor confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of observations when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly growth rate in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 0.2% signals weak labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending power and corporate hiring slowdowns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS growth rate < 0.2% in 1 month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
